notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
We always listen to your feedback and as a result we're happy to introduce a new game mode!

This update contains a third game mode that offers hard puzzles while having no plot whatsoever. No characters, no narrative, just the puzzles. We have also extended the log window so more text can appear on the screen at once.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Added:
-Dialogue log. You can access it from pause menu and read previous conversations with other characters.
-Interactable birds AI on every level. 
Fixed:
-Major correction of Spanish and French translation
-Stuck spot at 4th level.
-Interaction problem on 2nd level. 
-Hint not showing up sometimes on 2nd level.
-Other small improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.02b
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- A glitch that could cause player to get stuck on 5th level.
- Puzzle panel that was still interactive after solving the puzzle on 4th level.
- Minor collision and other small improvements.

notes.title: Patch 1.02a
notes.notes: -Fixed an autosave on third level that upon loading could make a player unable to progress further.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
-Minor language corrections to certain languages.
-Fixed chinese language support. Now the game properly shows punctuation and on top of that we have improved the translation itself too.
-Improved interaction with puzzles. It was difficult to interact with some puzzles, especially on the first and third level. Now it's easy as 1-2-3!
-Minor improvements to Amia.
-Minor UX consistency improvements.
-Minor optimization improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed:
-Ability to interact with puzzles via preview function on third level.
-Players getting stuck on third level before solving necessary puzzles and being unable to go back.
-Added missing localization for some languages
-For some players the default game language was polish, now game defaults to english if there's no native localization.
Other changes:
-On hard difficulty voice hints have been removed from it to make it even harder for those who love the challenge.
